items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence: the name of the index (provided in the command line) is not being used to create the directory (an automatic name is generated).
items.rationale: It says the specified name is ignored in favor of an autogenerated one, which is the mechanism the fix changes in search_query. It doesn't name a location or give the change.
